title: Bake with the lid on
vo: Put the lid back on, and slide the pot into the oven. Bake for 20 minutes with the lid on.
voUS: Put the lid back on, and slide the pot into the oven. Bake for 20 minutes with the lid on.
cap: Lid back on. Bake for 20 minutes at 250 °C (230 °C fan).
capUS: Lid back on. Bake for 20 minutes at 480 °F (445 °F convection).
